source: Fontsource packages via jsDelivr; SIL Open Font License 1.1

packs.core: Latin letters for the Classic, Modern and Editorial type sets (bundled in every skill)
packs.sets: Latin letters for the Technical, Geometric, Garamond and Swiss type sets
packs.europe: accented Latin for Central and Eastern European languages, Turkish and Vietnamese
packs.cyrillic-greek: Cyrillic (Russian, Ukrainian, Bulgarian, Serbian and more) and Greek
packs.arabic: Arabic script (Persian, Arabic, Urdu), set right to left
